notes: Read help (no labels). Longitudinal body-fat around menarche, girls (id) over time (centred at menarche); menarche is age at menarche. Hand sample #61: MLMUS4 exercise 7.6 fits fat ~ time + after + (1+time+after|id), after = pmax(time, 0) the hinge at menarche, intercept and slopes correlated; time, age and menarche are algebraically redundant, so only time is kept. after is no column, so covariates and random_slopes hold time and the formula records the hinge.
